primary_anchor_estimand: Four-level published-diagnosis association with BALF species composition among 400 unique PRJNA1056765 patients, estimated by cohort-specific Aitchison PERMANOVA R2 and qualified by PERMDISP.
primary_external_estimand: Drug_Resistance versus Drug_Sensitive tuberculosis association with BALF species composition among 130 unique PRJCA046985 subjects, estimated by cohort-specific Aitchison PERMANOVA R2 and qualified by PERMDISP.
major_scientific_limitations: The four-diagnosis anchor contrast and binary TB drug-resistance contrast are not one clinical estimand and cannot be pooled or formally meta-analyzed.
Upstream host state, read architecture and source processing differ despite a common Kraken2 database, parameter set and report grammar.
Classified fractions are low and variable; direct-assigned-read subcompositions are classifier-dependent and do not measure absolute microbial burden.
Run-linked age, sex, recent antibiotics, treatment, severity and comorbidity covariates are not available for a common adjusted design.
Technical-batch information is incomplete; the anchor spans 2021-2023 and the external deposited reads have heterogeneous nominal/observed length provenance.
PRJCA046985 has no identified public negative-control run, limiting contamination assessment for sparse taxon-level claims.
